name: rails-postgres
title: Ruby on Rails + Postgres (Kamal / Fly / Render)
summary: Ruby 3.3+ web app: Rails 7.2 or 8, ActiveRecord with timestamped migrations and db/schema.rb (or structure.sql), Postgres, RSpec or minitest, RuboCop for lint and format, Brakeman for static security, Hotwire (Turbo + Stimulus) for UI, Docker image deployed with Kamal 2 (or Fly.io / Render), GitHub Actions CI.
recommended_for: a server-rendered product where one team owns the whole app, wants a mature ORM and conventions over a component stack, and prefers running its own containers (or a simple PaaS) over a serverless platform
not_for: CLI tools, data pipelines, mobile apps, latency-critical edge rendering, or teams already committed to a JavaScript framework

commands.dev: bin/dev (falls back to bin/rails server; see Procfile.dev)
commands.typecheck: none by default (Sorbet `bundle exec srb tc` or RBS/Steep optional)
commands.e2e: bundle exec rspec spec/system (minitest: bin/rails test:system)
commands.build: docker build -t <app>:$(git rev-parse HEAD) . (Kamal builds this for you on deploy)
commands.migrate_prod: <scripts/migrate-prod.sh: verifies DATABASE_URL host, runs db:migrate:status, demands typed confirmation, then db:migrate>
commands.deploy: kamal deploy (Fly: fly deploy; Render: git push to the tracked branch; CI-gated in all three, see WORKFLOW.md)

format_cmd: bundle exec rubocop -a (set SENIOR_MODE_FORMAT_CMD for the post-edit hook)
migration_tool: ActiveRecord migrations (db/migrate/<timestamp>_*.rb; applied versions tracked in schema_migrations; watermark = timestamp version; strong_migrations gem for safe DDL)
date_helpers: app/helpers/date_helper.rb (<format_date, format_calendar_date>); always Time.current / Date.current, never Time.now / Date.today
app_verifier_boot: bin/dev (Puma on :3000, plus asset watchers from Procfile.dev), then drive the changed routes with a system spec (Capybara) or curl against /up and the changed paths

overlay.rules: rules/*.md replace the core api-boundary/data-layer/services/scripts rules (the core ui.md stays; adapt it to ERB + Turbo + Stimulus)
overlay.qa_pack: none in this profile; reuse the core QA-SWEEP template with a Capybara page sweep
